fields.label: Environment
fields.description: Mock never contacts FBR: it issues numbers starting MOCK- so a POS, its receipts and the retry queue can be tried safely. Use Sandbox for FBR's test system and Production only once FBR has approved the POS. Applies to FBR POS and to Digital Invoicing of POS sales; Sales Invoices reported by hand still follow Pakistan Tax Settings.

fields.label: Give Up After (tries)
fields.description: A sale that cannot reach FBR is retried with growing waits (30 seconds up to 1 hour), then marked Failed so a manager can retry it.

fields.label: FBR POS (Tier-1 retailers)
fields.description: Digital Invoicing of POS sales uses Pakistan Tax Settings (token, environment details).

fields.label: FBR POS Service URL
fields.description: Endpoint FBR gave you for posting invoices. To confirm against FBR's documentation: no default is assumed.

fields.label: POS ID
fields.description: The POS ID FBR registered for this business or terminal.

fields.label: Seller NTN
fields.description: Leave empty to use the Company's NTN, then Tax ID.

fields.label: Notice
fields.default: Verify this invoice through the FBR Tax Asaan mobile app or by SMS to 9966.

fields.label: FBR Logo
fields.description: Upload the logo FBR supplied. Until then a plain FBR text mark is shown.
